section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION - Front Wheel Alignment
title: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION - Front Wheel Alignment

content.description: Top view diagram showing wheel angle measurement positions. Shows left and right wheels with positions A (Inside) and B (Outside) marked, with an arrow indicating front direction.

content.text: Remove the caps of the knuckle stopper bolts and check the steering angles.
When the steering wheel is fully turned, make sure that the wheel is not touching the body or brake flexible hose.

content.description: Detailed illustration of knuckle stopper bolt area showing bolt location and adjustment mechanism on wheel assembly

content.text: If steering angles differ from standard value, adjust the wheel angle with the knuckle stopper bolts.
If the wheel angle still cannot be adjusted within limits, inspect and replace any damaged or worn steering parts.
5. ADJUST CAMBER AND STEERING AXIS INCLINATION

content.description: Side view diagram showing axis inclination and camber angle measurement at 90 degrees on front suspension strut assembly
Side view diagram showing caster angle measurement at 90 degrees from vertical on wheel and suspension assembly, viewed from front

content.text: If caster is out of tolerance, adjust it at the staked nut of the strut bar.
Decrease caster by lengthening the strut bar.
Increase caster by shortening the strut bar. One turn of the nut changes caster by 8'.
If caster still cannot be adjusted within limits, inspect and replace damaged or worn front suspension parts.

content.description: Detailed illustration showing strut bar adjustment nut location and tool positioning for caster adjustment
